summary.text: Dianne Blais, a Green Party candidate who has worked as vice-president of a privately held company, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Virginia's 11th District to James Walkinshaw.
She is a native of Washington state who grew up in Fairfax County and holds a degree in economics.

paragraphs.text: Blais is a native of Washington state who moved to Fairfax County in eighth grade, according to the Virginia Mercury, and she is a former co-president of the League of Women Voters and the American Association of University Women.
She earned a B.A. in economics from Mary Washington and, according to Ballotpedia, her professional experience includes working as vice-president of a privately held company.
She received 1.2% of the vote to James Walkinshaw's 74.3%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
